format: UTF-8 CSV with one header row
scope: Documentation schema for preserved source format, not the destination JP/TW query/build schema
null_representation: empty string in CSV; null in JSON where originally present

column_definitions.id: Stable source-specific typed entity identifier; no cross-source place conflation
column_definitions.code: Source identifier string; preserve leading zeros
column_definitions.source_type: Source role classification used by the adapter
column_definitions.category: Adapter category; statistical roles do not prove independent legal government status
column_definitions.name: Preserved UTF-8 source name
column_definitions.lang: Source-supported language tag, or und when unknown; not an inferred translation
column_definitions.parent_id: Immediate parent entity ID in this country anchors/localities union; blank only at country root
column_definitions.state_code: Registered region code matching the index region; not necessarily source numeric state code
column_definitions.address_country: Source address-country distinction; US Puerto Rico rows retain PR
column_definitions.address_candidate: String 0 or 1: selection policy only, not deliverability or legal-status evidence
column_definitions.postcodes: Pipe-separated postcode associations; empty means no associations loaded, not no postcode exists
column_definitions.postcode_relations: Parallel pipe-separated evidence labels; no associations loaded in these four snapshots
column_definitions.government_status: Preserved source/adapter government or statistical status; empty if not supplied
column_definitions.department_code: Shared export field, empty for these four country snapshots
column_definitions.collectivity_code: Shared export field, empty for these four country snapshots
column_definitions.source_state_code: Original national numeric state/province code string
column_definitions.census_division_code: Canadian four-character CDUID string; exact parent-code evidence
column_definitions.csd_type_code: Canadian source CSDTYPE code; retain distinctions
column_definitions.municipality_component: Mexican three-character cve_mun string; combine with two-character source_state_code
column_definitions.municipal_seat_locality_code: Mexican municipal-seat attribute; not an alternative municipality identity
column_definitions.municipal_seat_name: Mexican municipal-seat name attribute; not a municipality alias
column_definitions.statistics_available: String 0 or 1: whether separate 2020 statistical attributes were available to the adapter

hierarchy_rule: Every locality and non-root anchor parent resolves in the same country; all paths terminate at country:<CC>; every locality has its indexed state ancestor
